newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Silvermines sells last Irish property.
newsitem.headline: Silvermines sells last Irish property.

text.p: Silvermines Group Plc said on Friday that it had sold its remaining Irish investment property, Shannon Business Park, to a syndicate of private purchasers for 2.6 million Irish pounds net of expenses.
Silvermines said in a statement that it would use the proceeds from the sale to reduce its debt and would now focus on its UK-based electrical and electronic business.
Shannon Business Park, acquired in 1990, is currently valued at 2.2 million Irish pounds.

"This disposal completes the sale of Irish investment properties in accordance with the group's intention to dispose of all its property interests and focus on its electrical and electronic business principally centred in the UK," the company said.
